rules.generationName: the release app version, three numeric components
rules.immutable: a generation directory is never replaced; different bytes under an existing version are a typed refusal
rules.occupiedGenerations: never deleted, even outside the retention window
rules.programmedGenerations: never deleted while a launchd plist points at them
rules.replacedKeeper: never; the job is not repointed while the programmed generation owns sessions

rollback.refusedWhile: any keeper-owned session exists and the target build cannot service keeper-owned sessions
typedErrors: KEEPER_ROLLBACK_REFUSED naming the live keeper-owned session count

archive.checkedBy: scripts/assert-updater-archive-layout.mjs, on the packed updater archive before latest.json is published
archive.authority: the archive member, never target/ or the build tree; those hold pre-strip, pre-sign bytes

rules.digest: keeper.json.sha256 equals the sha256 of the archived ferryx-ptykeeper member
rules.executable: the archived member has an execute bit; mode 644 yields a generation directory that exists and cannot exec
rules.generation: keeper.json.version equals the archive's Info.plist CFBundleShortVersionString
rules.protocol: keeper.json.protocolMajor equals 1; compatibility is additive-only within a major
rules.runtimeFloor: per architecture, the keeper slice's minimum macOS is no newer than the daemon slice of the same architecture
rules.floorDocument: Contents/Resources/keeper/latest.json exists, states keeper.oldestSafeRollbackVersion, and names this generation

archive.runtimeFloorWhyPerArch: arm64 legitimately declares 11.0 while the app still supports 10.15 through its x86_64 slice, so a comparison against LSMinimumSystemVersion would refuse every correct universal build; the question is whether a machine that can run this daemon can run this keeper
archive.runtimeFloorReader: scripts/lib/keeper-macho.mjs (pure JS, LC_BUILD_VERSION and LC_VERSION_MIN_MACOSX), so the check needs no Xcode and no otool

launchdIndependence.requires: the keeper job is its own LaunchAgent whose executable lives outside the app bundle, so replacing the app cannot take the process that owns every PTY master down with it
launchdIndependence.verifiedBy: scripts/lib/keeper-launchd-job.mjs against a captured plist (plutil -convert xml1 -o - ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.ferryx.ptykeeper.plist)
refuses: the daemon label com.ferryx.daemon, or the QA label com.ferryx.qa.ptykeeper in a shipped job
a ProgramArguments[0] inside Ferryx.app, or one naming a previous generation
any argument at all; the endpoint is derived from the runtime, and --socket/--daemon* are not keeper modes
KeepAlive.SuccessfulExit other than false, or a missing AbandonProcessGroup
a missing SoftResourceLimits.NumberOfFiles of 4096, or log paths that are not keeper.stdout.log/keeper.stderr.log
launchdIndependence.antiDrift: scripts/release-keeper-launchd.test.mjs diffs the module's renderer against the Rust format! literal in keeper_launchd.rs
